---
name: Correction or source problem
about: Report a factual error, missing context, source problem, translation or usability issue.
title: '[Correction] '
---

## Page
Include the page link, with an episode, evidence or source anchor if relevant.

## Type of problem
Factual claim / historical framing / source or broken link / translation / usability / other.

## What should change, and why?
Quote the relevant wording or describe the problem.

## Evidence or sources
For factual corrections, include source titles, links and precise locations where possible.

## Suggested correction
Optional: propose replacement wording or another way to resolve the problem.
